result.topic_en: A note on 'astral' (non-Euclidean) geometry giving the volume of an infinitely thin solid between a triangle ABC and a second plane through abc, using an imaginary-argument sine of the altitude AD.
result.transcription:
Math 34 [-157 d/10-]
Astralgéometrie
(1)
Aa, Bb, Cc
normal gegen die Ebene
worin das Dreieck ABC
Durch abc eine zweite
Ebene
Aa kleinster Abstand
der beiden Ebnen, und selbst unendlich klein
AB[?] normal gegen BC.
Dann ist
Volumen ABCabc $= \frac{1}{2} Aa . BC . \frac{\sin i\, AD}{i}$

methods.what: Volume of an infinitesimally thin prism-like solid over a triangle in non-Euclidean (astral) geometry, with a circular function of imaginary argument replacing the Euclidean altitude
